title: Propasafe-Hybrid: A Text-Based Hybrid Propaganda Detection Tool
abstract: arXiv:2610.33464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Propagandistic content increasingly circulates through online news and social media, where readers often encounter it with limited scrutiny, highlighting the need for reliable and fine-grained detection. This paper introduces Propasafe-Hybrid, a sentence-level system that integrates a fine-tuned transformer classifier with LLM-based technique classification to identify, label, and explain specific propaganda strategies. The pipeline generates actionable outputs, including highlighted sentences, technique assignments, and concise rationales, so users can immediately understand why a sentence was flagged and how each label was determined. To control inference cost, Propasafe-Hybrid employs a cost-aware pre-filtering stage that forwards only high-likelihood sentences to LLMs, reducing token usage while preserving the underlying decision logic. translated_title: Propasafe-Hybrid：一种基于文本的混合式宣传检测工具
translated_abstract: 宣传性内容日益在网络新闻和社交媒体中传播，读者在接触这些内容时往往缺乏足够的审视，这凸显了对可靠且细粒度检测方法的需求。本文提出了 Propasafe-Hybrid，这是一个句子级别的系统，它将微调后的 Transformer 分类器与基于大语言模型（LLM）的宣传技巧分类相结合，以识别、标注并解释具体的宣传策略。该流程生成可操作的输出结果，包括高亮句子、技巧分类以及简洁的判定依据，使用户能够立即理解某个句子为何被标记，以及每个标签是如何确定的。为了控制推理成本，Propasafe-Hybrid 采用了一种成本感知的预过滤阶段，仅将高可能性的句子转发给大语言模型，在保留底层决策逻辑的同时降低了 token 使用量。这些设计选择共同提升了系统的可解释性、效率和实际可用性。
tldr: Propasafe-Hybrid 是一个将微调 Transformer 分类器与大语言模型宣传技巧分类相结合的句子级检测系统，并通过成本感知预过滤机制在降低推理成本的同时为用户提供可解释的宣传内容标注。
en_tdlr: Propasafe-Hybrid is a sentence-level propaganda detection system that integrates a fine-tuned transformer classifier with LLM-based technique classification, employing cost-aware pre-filtering to reduce inference costs while providing explainable propaganda annotations to users.
